cc:Work.dc:title: ILCOF-1 Building Fragments
cc:Work.dc:description: Connectivity schematic based on the supplied manual ILCOF-1_node.xyz and ILCOF-1_linker.xyz. Node C40H22 plus 4 He; linker C8H6N2 plus 2 He. Cuts at phenyl-imine-carbon single bonds. 2D drawing only, no optimisation or new scientific calculation.
